name: 镜花水月
description: 秘密选择本棋子4格内1个友方棋子。对方的下一个回合中，该棋子成为单体技能目标时，可将目标转移至本棋子3格内另1个敌方棋子。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var ally = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 4, filter: 'ally' }); if (!ally || ally.needsTargetSelection) return ally; caster.statusTags = (caster.statusTags || []).filter(function(tag) { return tag.type !== 'aizen-kyoka-active' && tag.type !== 'aizen-kyoka-secret'; }); var opponent = battle.players.find(function(player) { return player.playerId !== caster.ownerPlayerId; }); addStatusEffectById(caster.instanceId, { id: 'aizen-kyoka-active-' + caster.instanceId, type: 'aizen-kyoka-active', name: '镜花水月', visible: false, currentUses: 1, stacks: 1 }); addStatusEffectById(caster.instanceId, { id: 'aizen-kyoka-secret-' + caster.instanceId, type: 'aizen-kyoka-secret', name: '镜花水月·秘密目标', visible: false, currentUses: 1, stacks: 1, targetPieceId: ally.instanceId, opponentPlayerId: opponent && opponent.playerId }); return { success: true, message: caster.name + '发动镜花水月' }; }
